# PRISM Signals preview core

[Module map](../README.md) · [Source directory](../../../packages/prism-signals-core)

Own the PRISM Signals preview brand, test catalog offer, synthetic signal presentation and Telegram update planner.

**Scope:** Pure preview core; every commercial rail is off, rights are not evaluated, and the package is not an independent deployed product.

**Placement:** pnpm workspace member; package `@cambridge-tcg/prism-signals-core`.

## Progress

Source review recorded **2026-09-28**. Preview catalog, presentation, Telegram planner and tests are present. The README records extraction/build and clean-consumer release gates as future work.

This records source and documentation evidence. It does not establish deployment, external access, service health, or passing tests.

**Next review:** Keep the synthetic preview explicit. Complete package build and consumer validation before any separately authorized extraction or publication.
